title: 行事の飾り枠セット
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Flat colourful style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 運動会、賞状、お正月、お月見、ハロウィン、卒業、給食、お弁当、ポップなど、行事とくらしの飾り枠12点。中があいているので、おたよりや掲示物にそのまま使えます。
